title: Define these concepts for yourself
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: If someone asked you to say, in one line, what love is, or truth, or beauty, could you? Most of us never decided.

groups.heading: What do you think love is?

lines.text: You can read probably a hundred books on the concept of love, Jose said. And marriage as an institution gives us a definition of love, does it not?

As we get older we go: wait a second. This is what I was told it was, but there are all these variables. I think it is important for me to define love, he said, in order to understand what love is between me and the other person.
As Jose reads the author, he did not get much of a taste of that: defining love for himself.
As entrepreneurs, Jose said, we have to have a balance in our relationships. You can't just say: look, I'm paying the rent, I'm paying the kids' school, get off my back. That's not how it works.
So what do you think love is, he asked? What do you think truth is? What do you think beauty is? We don't go to university and learn them. We define them as we go along.
A student said: taking care of the other person, taking care of yourself, having responsibility with each other, and patience when there are problems. Jose said: a sense of selflessness.
Another said you have to put your feelings aside and let go of winning. It is not getting walked all over. It is sometimes letting the other person win.
Jose said the foundation is not that she is beautiful or has a great personality. It is much deeper. What are the values of the other person? What is their purpose in life?
The more we define them, he said, the more chance we have of finding somebody we are in congruence with. And define it ourselves: what is important to me in love?
One of his own must-haves, he said, with his friends who are entrepreneurs, is that we value the time you put into fatherhood. The time, not the money.
A student said the measure is what sacrifices you are willing to make for the other person. Another gave one word: unconditional. Jose said that is a very good word.
Jose asked what love becomes when you have been in the same routine for years. A student said you need some commonality, more of a friendship and a partnership.

It transforms, Jose said. First everything is new. Then we get to the routine, we have to pay the bills, and now we have kids. Love gets distilled into other things. It is still important, but it becomes something else.
He said purpose matters for a couple too. Some people have a crisis when the children leave, because the whole life was about the kids. Or the business becomes more important than the relationship.

The lesson, Jose said: define these concepts for yourself, love and marriage and all these things, because you don't want them to be defined for you, or be unaware. You want to go to the core of why you are with that person, and why you love that person.
What do you think love is?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what love is, in one line.
Write what truth is, in one line.
Write what beauty is, in one line.
Write three values you need in a partner or a close business partner.
Write one sentence about your purpose together, or what you want to build with the people closest to you.

check.q: What did Jose say we do not learn at university?
choices: What love, truth and beauty mean

check.q: Which one word for love did a student give that Jose called a very good word?
Why did Jose say to define these concepts for yourself?
choices: So they are not defined for you and you are not unaware

recap: Define love, truth and beauty for yourself, so they are not defined for you.
